manifestations.description: tenderness over the left side of his abdomen and left chest
multiple superficial skin abrasions over his left hand, left knee and both shins
cannot tolerate prolonged standing, walking or sitting; has to take a rest or change the posture after standing, walking or sitting for about 2 hours
unable to ride a motorcycle as he feels pain in the pelvis and gets cramps in his hip
feels pain in his pelvis and hip when he carries weights of over 10 kgs or when he stands from a squatting position
reduced the frequency of sexual intercourse with his wife as he feels pain in his pelvis and hip
pain, residual weakness and tendency for easy muscle cramping will place some restrictions on the plaintiff’s employability

treatments_received: Open reduction and internal fixation of his right acetabular fracture performed on 24 June 2000
admitted to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital on 2000-06-12 and discharged on 2000-07-08

losses.description: cannot tolerate prolonged standing, walking or sitting. He has to take a rest or change the posture after standing, walking or sitting for about 2 hours.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: The plaintiff is no longer able to play football or engage in war games which activities he enjoyed before the accident.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: He has also reduced the frequency of sexual intercourse with his wife as he feels pain in his pelvis and hip.

It would not be suitable for him to work as a courier as he did before the accident as this requires long walking and carrying heavy objects. His employability is therefore restricted and he would have a disadvantage in the labour market.
